title: AI Governance Tactic Playbook

approval_record.approval_scope: Approval covers the source-defined tactic definitions and Primary object / mapping relationships; it excludes exact KB finding/question mappings and operational enrichment not present in the source.

authority_boundary: Approved Primary object / mapping relationships retrieve candidate tactics for findings on those objects. Tactics remain advisory: selection and completion create only roadmap work, new evidence and reassessment; they do not directly close findings, clear hard gates, establish legal compliance, accept residual risk, or authorize lifecycle progression.
catalog_rules: Tactic completion creates new evidence and requires reassessment; tactics remain advisory.
No tactic directly closes a finding, clears a hard gate, establishes legal compliance, accepts residual risk, or authorizes lifecycle progression.

A locked finding retrieves candidate tactics through its assessed capability or anti-pattern and the approved Primary object / mapping; each selected candidate retains finding-level grounding in the assessment result.
